args.title: checkout-api v2.3.1 failing health checks — rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: After the deploy of checkout-api v2.3.1 to all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), the service failed health checks with an error rate of 18%. v2.3.1-rc was also marked unhealthy in staging. Rolled checkout-api back in all regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. After the rollback, all regions run v2.3.0, the service is healthy, and the error rate is down to 0.2%. Follow-up: find the root cause of the v2.3.1 failure before redeploying it.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions, and it's passing health checks again. I also opened a SEV2 incident for it.

- **What went wrong:** v2.3.1 was running in us-east, us-west and eu-west, failing health checks with an 18% error rate. Its release candidate (v2.3.1-rc) had already been marked unhealthy in staging.
- **Rollback:** v2.3.0 is the most recent release that was healthy in production. All three regions now run it, and the error rate is down to 0.2%.
- **Incident:** INC-0001 (SEV2) describes the failure, the rollback and the recovery, and the on-call engineer has been paged. It also says to find out why v2.3.1 failed before deploying it again.

content.text: The most recent healthy production release is v2.3.0.
